title_en: Information Session on Fall 2027 Outbound Exchange Student Recruitment
summary: Undergraduate and graduate students interested in studying at a foreign university as outbound exchange students for Fall 2027 are invited to an information session. The session is held on Friday, 30 October 2026, either from 10:00 to 11:30 or from 14:00 to 15:30 (both sessions have the same content), in the 1st-floor Seminar Room of Building 152 (CJ International Center). Further details are available on the Office of International Affairs notice linked in the notice.
applies_to: Undergraduate and graduate students who are interested in being sent to a foreign university as exchange students (Fall 2027 outbound exchange semester). The notice does not state that attendance is mandatory.

dates.what: Information session, morning session (same content as the afternoon session)
Information session, afternoon session (same content as the morning session)

conditions: The morning and afternoon sessions cover the same content, so students need to attend only one of them.
The notice does not state that attendance is mandatory or that prior registration is required.
steps: Read the detailed information on the Office of International Affairs website: https://oga.snu.ac.kr/outgoing_notice-board/?mod=document&uid=3125
Attend one session on Friday, 30 October 2026 (10:00–11:30 or 14:00–15:30) in the 1st-floor Seminar Room of Building 152 (CJ International Center).
For questions, contact the Office of International Affairs; the contact details are given in the original notice.
translation:
Information Session on Fall 2027 (2027학년도 2학기) Outbound Exchange Student Recruitment

1. Date and time: Friday, 30 October 2026, 10:00–11:30 (morning) / 14:00–15:30 (afternoon)
* The same content is presented twice, once in the morning and once in the afternoon.

2. Venue: Seminar Room, 1st floor, Building 152 (CJ International Center)

3. Main content: General information about the outbound exchange semester

4. Intended audience: Undergraduate and graduate students interested in being sent to a foreign university

5. Detailed information: https://oga.snu.ac.kr/outgoing_notice-board/?mod=document&uid=3125

6. Inquiries: A staff member of the Office of International Affairs (국제처); the contact details are given in the original notice. End.
